title: deps: bump objectui's @objectstack/* to 17.7.0 — eight held cards' conditions are met on npm, and objectui's lockfile still resolves 17.6.0
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination node**. One change unblocks many held cards. Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) at the unlock scan after `@objectstack/spec` **17.7.0** reached npm (published 2026-10-06T12:22Z). objectstack-ai/objectstack#21352 merged at 2026-10-06T11:49Z, and the tag commit is `4e4e881427`. The shape is objectui#11438's, the 17.6.0 bump. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why one card

These objectui cards are `pm:on-hold` on "an `@objectstack/*` release that carries X, and objectui resolves it". Each X was tested against the 17.7.0 tag commit `4e4e881427` with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`.

| card | its condition | 17.7.0 |
|---|---|---|
| objectui#11649 | carries `f5b8e29e37` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21890) | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11645 | carries `48297ad980` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21833) | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11545 | carries `6dd99b82c3` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21566) | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11439 | carries `39119014dc` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21344) | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11428 | carries `dcc5ef4c5a` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21256) | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11389 | carries `99e1912afc` (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21342) | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11334 (p1) | carries `32d5769080` | ✅ in tag |
| objectui#11417 | carries `32d5769080` | ✅ in tag |

**Not released by 17.7.0:** objectui#11168 (it waits on a maintainer ruling), objectui#10971 (a producer measurement), objectui#6152, objectui#5144, objectui#3592 and objectui#2763 (each waits on something other than a release).

objectui `origin/main` still declares `"@objectstack/spec": "^17.6.0"` in `packages/types/package.json`, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` (read at filing). Every row above names "objectui resolves it" as half its trigger. Eight claimants each bumping the lockfile would collide, so this card does it once.

## The change

- Update objectui's `@objectstack/*` dependencies to 17.7.0, and regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml` with the repository's own tooling. ⛔ Never edit it by hand.
- Where a package will import a 17.7.0-only export, raise that package's declared floor (`^17.7.0`). The consuming card may do this instead: say which in the PR.
- **The mirror rides this PR.** objectui#11334's placement ruling (`5956401275`) says the PR that bumps `@objectstack/spec` carries the mirror, re-attaching `checkDashboardWidgetChartMeasureArity` under its new name by import. objectui#11417 closes with it. ⛔ No second copy of the check.
- Run the full gate set. 17.7.0 also carries changes objectui did not ask for. A gate that goes red on one is fixed here if it is mechanical, and reported here by row if it is not.

## One red the bump will meet, by design

This is from the cross-lane memo of `domain:spec @ objectui` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, comment `6016611286`).
- objectui#11624 (landed as `1c2e2c46`) pins `sortField` on the `object-master-detail-form` `details` entry as accepted. 17.7.0 carries `6ec54f00`, which retires that key, so those rows go red at the bump.
- The bump flips them to refused, with the spec's retired-key message. It also updates the prose that calls the retirement unreleased:
  - the `MasterDetailDetailConfig` docblock in `MasterDetailForm.tsx`;
  - the header of `masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx` and the header of the types pin;
  - the `details` registration description in `plugin-form`'s `index.tsx`;
  - the console parity row `object-master-detail-form.details`.

## After it lands

Each row above then has its `Restart-when:` met. Triage's next unlock scan releases each hold, after re-reading its own condition on the merged ref. ⛔ No hold is released by this card's own act.
